title: Spreadsheet-First Front-End for imuGAP
text: Two input modes. Use single .xlsx workbook directory containing observations, locations, target files (CSV RDS). imurun derives imuGAP’s population rows observation’s location, reference cohort, age span, dose. Bundled template example workbooks. imurun_init() writes blank template instructions sampler configuration; imurun_copy_example() writes complete example derived imuGAP’s *_sim data. Friendly validation. Inputs checked canonical schema ([IMURUN_SCHEMA]) via layer imuGAP’s canonicalizers names offending sheet, column, row collects every problem can find rather stopping first. Validate-mode. run_fit(c("-h", <input>)) checks workbook without fitting. Human-readable results. success, input workbook gains results sheet containing medians credible intervals beside request context; fit.rds also saved advanced post-processing. Scriptable. engine functions (run_fit(), read_inputs(), validate_inputs(), read_workbook(), friends) exported use directly R. optional CLI wrapper returns shell exit codes (0 success, 1 validation, 2 model, 3 /O) use pipelines.

what: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: spreadsheet-first fitting entry point, also used optional imurun command wrapper. Given workbook directory inputs, validates observations, locations, target requests, workbook configuration; fits imuGAP::sampling(); writes fit.rds; adds human-readable results sheet supplied workbook (creates results.xlsx directory input). function never throws expected failure modes; instead prints human-readable message returns integer exit code, can drive shell command directly. exit-code taxonomy : 0 Success (usage/validation-request). 1 Input validation failed: schema, invalid unknown command-line option. 2 Model fitting failed. 3 Input/output error (missing directory, unreadable unwritable files).

code: # Usage text, no fitting: run_fit(character(0)) #> imurun.R -- Minimal CLI for imuGAP model fitting #>  #> Usage: imurun <input> [output_dir] [sampler options] #>        imurun -h <input>              (validate only, no model fitting) #>        imurun init [dir]              (write a blank input template workbook) #>        imurun example [dir]           (write a filled example workbook) #>        imurun -h | --help             (show this message) #>  #> <input> is either a directory of CSV/RDS files or a single .xlsx workbook. #>  #> A directory must contain: #>   observations.csv (or .rds)      -- columns: obs_id, loc_id, cohort, age_min, age_max, dose, #>                                      positive, sample_n. cohort is the reference cohort, that of #>                                      age_max; a single 'age' column works for a one-age count. #>   locations.csv (or .rds)         -- columns: loc_id, parent_id (hierarchical; see package docs) #>  #> A workbook must have one sheet per input with the same column names #> (run 'imurun init' to get a correctly-headed template). #>  #> Sampler options belong in the workbook's 'configuration' sheet. The generated #> template supplies iter=2000 and chains=4; seed and warmup may be left blank. #> For automation and older workflows, these flags override the sheet: #>   --iter N        total iterations per chain (default 2000) #>   --chains N      number of chains (default 4) #>   --seed N        random seed for reproducibility #>   --warmup N      warmup iterations per chain #> Flags may appear anywhere and may be written --iter N or --iter=N. #>  #> Output options: #>   --results PATH  write an amended copy instead of updating the input workbook #>   --csv PATH      also write a results-only CSV #>   --overwrite     replace existing output files (otherwise imurun refuses) #>  #> Output: for workbook input, a 'results' sheet of per-target medians and credible #> intervals is added to that workbook; directory input writes results.xlsx. #> fit.rds is also written for post-processing. output_dir defaults to input_dir. #> Exit codes: 0=success, 1=validation, 2=model, 3=I/O.  # Validate inputs only (no Stan toolchain required): dir <- tempfile("imurun_validate_") dir.create(dir) if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Fit, amend the workbook, and write fit.rds (requires a Stan toolchain): run_fit("path/to/inputs") } # }

title: imurun 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Exported core CLI engine ordinary R functions: run_fit(), read_inputs(), load_by_ext(), find_input_file(), check_all_inputs(). Added install_cli() put bundled imurun command PATH. Added .xlsx workbook input mode: read_inputs() now accepts either directory CSV/RDS files single workbook one sheet per input, via new read_workbook(). Missing sheets reported . Pinned canonical input schema IMURUN_SCHEMA shipped blank template workbook (inst/templates/imurun_template.xlsx) plus small filled example (inst/extdata/imurun_example.xlsx) derived imuGAP’s *_sim data; resolve imurun_template() / imurun_example(). Added imurun_init() imurun_copy_example() (imurun init / imurun example subcommands) scaffold workbooks directory. Added validate_inputs(), friendly validation layer imuGAP canonicalizers reports every problem spreadsheet terms. Observations now describe inclusive age range (age_min/age_max, labeled Youngest age / Oldest age) rather single age. count covering several ages expands one imuGAP population row per age, weighted equally, ages form observation’s coverage mixture. sheet carrying single age column still read, one-age range. Renamed observations target cohort column Birth cohort Reference cohort, documented cohort row’s oldest age: cohorts younger ages derived age plus cohort stays constant, matching target sheet already expanded. former Birth cohort header still accepted. run_fit() now writes human-readable result, just fit.rds. target sheet expanded, predicted, summarized results sheet workbook user supplied, preserving existing sheets formatting. --results writes amended copy instead, --csv writes results-CSV. Existing results replaced unless --overwrite passed. target configuration sheets validated fitting, bad row sampler setting fails immediately rather model runs. Generated workbooks now include configuration sheet iter, chains, seed, warmup. Command-line flags remain available explicit automation/compatibility overrides. Set development infrastructure: R CMD check, lint, test coverage, pkgdown, spelling continuous-integration workflows.
